A '''line platoon''' or '''infantry platoon''' was a formation in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A line platoon, also known as a light platoon, was comprised of four [[line squad]]s, a commanding [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and a [[Sergeant major/Legends|sergeant major]] as [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] adjutant, for a total of thirty-eight [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="ISB" /> Line platoons could be augmented by the addition of four more [[line squad]]s.<ref name="ISB2" />
